默认50ms，普通用户不建议调整这个值，具体调整方式见文档: Default: 50 ms. Most users should keep this value; see the documentation for details
默认ItemV2且推荐，如果出现问题可尝试切换，GridIcon 在合成台与背包: ItemV2 is the default and recommended model. Switch to the other one if you run into problems; GridIcon is recognized incompletely on the synthesis bench and in inventory counting tasks.
默认为 F，自带了 E 和 G 按键，需要改成其他键的请阅读文档: Default is F. E and G are also included. See the docs to change them
默认使用键鼠监听 F8，可在右侧切换为全局热键: Uses Keyboard/Mouse Listener F8 by default; switch to a global hotkey on the right
默认使用键鼠监听：Down 显示或隐藏小窗、Up 播放或暂停、Left 快退、R: Uses the Keyboard/Mouse Listener by default: Down shows or hides the mini window, Up plays or pauses, Left seeks backward, Right seeks forward. Other hotkeys are empty by default. Arrow keys are also passed to the game.
默认使用领奖界面当前档位: By default, uses the current option on the reward screen
默认关闭，奖励识别失败即结束任务。开启后，当前材料按原预规划树脂预算继续，不再动: Off by default: the task ends if reward recognition fails. When enabled, the current material continues with the originally planned resin budget, without dynamic estimation
默认关闭，开启后浓缩和原粹不足时使用: Off by default; when on, used after Condensed and Original run out
默认关闭，开启后须臾不可用时使用: Off by default; when on, used when Transient is unavailable
默认关闭，适用于秘境难度未解锁时自动选择可用难度: Off by default. Automatically selects an available difficulty when the Domain difficulty is not unlocked
默认开启，用于动态调整刷取次数；关闭后不更新库存，按初始预计体力刷取，实际材料可: On by default, used to dynamically adjust farm counts; when off, inventory is not updated and farming uses the initially estimated resin, so actual materials may differ
默认拾取未被排除的内容: Pick up non-excluded items by default
默认根据 PNG 文件名生成大驼峰名称，手动修改后不再自动覆盖: By default, a PascalCase name is generated from the PNG filename and will not be overwritten after you edit it
默认由 GPU 完成 BGRA→BGR 打包；开启后回退为 CPU 转换，用于对: By default, the GPU performs BGRA→BGR packing; when enabled, falls back to CPU conversion for comparison testing; takes effect after restarting capture
鼠标不在小窗上时的不透明度、置顶与位置。鼠标移到小窗上时总是 100% 显示: Opacity, always-on-top, and position when the mouse is not over the mini window. Always shown at 100% when the mouse is over it
鼠标穿透时，鼠标经过小窗会自动淡化，露出下方的游戏画面，方便点击被挡住的按钮: During click-through, the mini window fades when the mouse passes over it, revealing the game below so you can click covered buttons
鼠标键：left、right、middle、x1、x2。按键原样发送，不经过游戏: Mouse buttons: left, right, middle, x1, x2. Keys are sent as-is, without game keybinding mapping.
